title: Respiratory Monitoring During Right Heart
brief_summary: Respiratory monitoring during right heart catheterization to differentiate between various types of pulmonary hypertension; The effects of the cardiovascular system on the lung mechanical properties.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing right heart catheterization

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability or unwillingness to follow or to sign the study protocol.
study_population: Patients undergoing right heart catheterization (RHC) for the evaluation of heart failure and pulmonary hypertension, based on the regular clinical practice.
